title: Production composition root: wire scheduler, automation service, durable store and adapters into one runnable entrypoint
goal: Close the gap WP-14 reported: AutomatedCycleService and Scheduler exist only with test fixtures for cycleRepository, stageDriver and leaseStore. Build the real composition in packages/adapters (the only package allowed to carry npm dependencies) so that one command starts the autonomous loop: read the operator state file, run the scheduler, and drive a full cycle through the real modules (durable store as cycle repository, on-disk lease store, a stage driver that maps each cycle stage to CycleRunner plus the adapters: fund from the vault via hook-contract-client, bridge outbound via relay-client and the route executor, buy and open the pack and sell via the Collector Crypt buyback with collector-crypt, bridge the proceeds back, snapshot holders and compile the pro-rata manifest, obtain the signer and verifier approvals, submit the payout via settlement-worker). Dry run by default: with liveMode false every stage performs only read-only probes and records what it would do; with liveMode true mutations go through the injected signer client. Configuration and credentials come from environment variables or an operator-supplied module path, never from files inside the repository.
readSet: packages/runner/test/integration/full-cycle-dry-run.test.mjs and automated-cycle.test.mjs (how the fixtures compose the seams)
steps: Read the seams first: list every method AutomatedCycleService, Scheduler and settlement-worker require from cycleRepository, stageDriver, leaseStore and the signer/verifier clients, and write them down as a table in docs/modules/composition-root.md before coding

cycle-repository.mjs: adapt the WP-27 durable store to the cycleRepository interface (readActiveCycle, createCycle, readStage, completeStage, and whatever else the service requires); lease-store.mjs: an on-disk lease store with atomic rename and heartbeat, single-process safe

stage-driver.mjs: one handler per stage; each handler has a probe path (liveMode false: read-only RPC and API calls, evidence recorded, no mutation) and an execute path (liveMode true: build calldata with hook-contract-client, sign via the injected signer client, broadcast via robinhood-rpc or solana-rpc, then observe until the reducer accepts the evidence); every stage is idempotent on retry and returns the evidence shape the reducer expects

compose.mjs: build everything from an explicit config object (paths, RPC URLs, API base URLs, chain ids from bindings/robinhood-chain.json, signer client instances) and return {scheduler, service, shutdown}; environment.mjs: read that config from environment variables and validate it with an exact schema, rejecting any field that looks like secret material in the repository tree

bin/hookemon-runner.mjs: CLI with subcommands run (start scheduler), tick (one tick then exit), dry-run (force liveMode false for one cycle), status (print the projection); add it to packages/adapters/package.json bin and document usage in README.md

Tests in packages/adapters/test/app: compose from a temp directory with fake RPC/API transports (the same injected-transport pattern the adapter tests use), run a complete dry-run cycle through the real scheduler, service, durable store and stage driver; prove that liveMode false never calls sign or broadcast; prove that a crash between stages resumes at the right stage after restart; prove the lease prevents two runners on the same directory
Run the whole adapters suite, the runner suite, scripts/tests and the clean-room scanner before committing
tests: cd packages/adapters && npm ci --ignore-scripts && node --test test/app/*.test.mjs
acceptance: One command (node packages/adapters/bin/hookemon-runner.mjs dry-run --state <file>) runs a complete cycle through the real scheduler, automation service, durable store and stage driver against injected fake transports and exits 0 with a written journal
With liveMode false no code path reaches signerClient.sign or any broadcast function (asserted by a test with throwing stubs)
A crash between stages resumes at the right stage on restart (durable store evidence)
The runner core (packages/runner) gains no npm dependency; all composition lives in packages/adapters
Configuration is validated with an exact schema, credentials come only from environment or an injected module, and nothing secret is written into the repository or the journal
notes: This is the package that makes the product actually runnable, so an R4 fresh-context reviewer is mandatory before merge and must check: liveMode gating, idempotency of every stage on retry, and that no key material is read by this package (only an injected signer client interface with sign/broadcast). Keep the owner product simple: default configuration is one pack per cycle every 20 minutes, dry run. If a needed adapter function does not exist yet, add the smallest missing function to the adapter in packages/adapters/src with a test, and say so in the report. If a seam mismatch in packages/runner blocks you (a method the service requires that the durable store cannot offer), do not edit packages/runner; report it as a blocker with the exact method name.
